Name: Beth-car
Description: The place as far as which Israel pursued the Philistines after the LORD thundered upon them at Mizpeh, and Samuel set up the stone Ebenezer between Mizpeh and Shen.
BiblicalSignificance: Beth-car is the end of a rout: pursued from Mizpeh to Beth-car, the Philistines were driven back and the stone of help was raised.
